# VEGA Mexican Cuisine

> EAT. DRINK. FIESTA. A modern take on traditional Mexican cuisine in Hartsdale, Westchester County, NY.

## Location & Contact
- Address: 189 E Hartsdale Ave, Hartsdale, NY 10530, USA
- Phone: (914) 723-0010
- Email: info@vegamexican.com
- Website: https://vegamexican.com

## Hours
- Monday–Thursday: 11:30 AM – 9:30 PM
- Friday–Saturday: 11:30 AM – 10:00 PM
- Sunday: 11:30 AM – 9:00 PM
